verdict.rationale: Gmail supports the standard IMAP and POP protocols for non-Gmail clients, and your messages and labels sync to clients like Thunderbird. Its API lists read-only mail extraction, backup and account migration as use cases, and messages use RFC 2822 MIME format, so mail can be pulled out in open, standard formats. However, there is no evidence of a first-party one-step export of all account data, or of exporting non-mail data such as filters and settings. missing for 10: a documented full-account export tool (e.g. an archive download in mbox or similar format), coverage of non-mail data such as contacts, filters and settings, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.
